channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: myna lists your product now, over MCP
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: myna 0.17.0 submits a product to a software directory over that directory's MCP server, including directories it has never heard of.

item.title: nichedb 0.5.0: the sea, the surf and the aircraft worth watching
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Every NOAA buoy in one file, the National Weather Service surf zone forecast beside it, and the ADS-B emergency squawks held as episodes rather than positions. Plus four things the live data decided, including the missing-value marker that turns a broken sensor into a flat calm.

item.title: nichedb 0.4.0: four feeds that only mean something together
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Three new collections in nichedb: aviation, water and consumer finance, plus the NTSB bulk accident archive. What the live data decided, including the search API that ignores its own offset and the bounding box that silently caps at 400 stations.

item.title: The HTML we have been writing around
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Chris Coyier's mid-2026 HTML roundup lines up almost item for item with code we wrote by hand: a 152-line PWA install hook, a 500-line React context that keeps one audio element alive across routes, and an iframe we ship only because CSS isolation had no other answer.

item.title: Podcasts, split by who serves the feed
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: NicheDB's podcasts collection splits the medium the one way no podcast app will: shows on a commercial host versus shows on the maker's own domain. 307 platform domains hold 93.8% of the live catalogue, and the head of a directory listing is inverted against everything behind it.

item.title: NicheDB 0.2.0: the domain layer, counted daily
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A new domains collection built from ntlddata.com's keyless CC-BY API: the new gTLDs counted daily, the launch pipeline, and the registries changing hands, plus everything merged since 0.1.0.

item.title: $100 an hour, per agent
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Consulting has always been priced in person-hours. I price it per agent, ten at a time, and the ceiling is different. Plus the job board that falls out of taking that seriously.

item.title: A green Connected badge and a payment that could not be sent
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An OAuth scope was silently dropped from every grant for four weeks. Nothing errored, 22 people could not invoice, and the answer was stored in our own database the whole time.

item.title: Three faults that only appear once you stop duplicating
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: watchnews.now read three news directories at once and now reads one. A unique slug the upsert could not see, a story filed under its publisher's first desk, and an import window narrower than one upstream refresh.

item.title: The feed that looked filtered
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: agenticjobs 0.5.0 makes one query work across HTML, JSON, RSS, Markdown and MCP. Two RSS feeds had been accepting filters and silently ignoring them, which is worse than not supporting them at all.
